newsitem.title: USA: Bristol to merge with Smyth Systems.
newsitem.headline: Bristol to merge with Smyth Systems.

text.p: Bristol Technology Systems Inc on Friday said it has reached a definitive agreement to merge with Smyth Systems Inc in a stock swap.

Financial details were undisclosed, but Bristol said the addition of Smyth will boost Bristol's annual revenues to over $30 million. Smyth will operate under its current management as a subsidiary of Bristol.

Based in Canton, Ohio, Smyth provides turnkey retail sales automation systems for specialty retailers, country clubs, resorts and museum stores. It also operate a point-of-sale systems dealership for supermarket and food stores.
Bristol Technology operates point-of-sale systems dealerships in Kentucky, Ohio, Washington and California.
